name: EDM LOVER
source:
EDM LOVER is an a gay Human x Furry Visual Novel with a fun, upbeat story about a an aspiring DJ/Music producer who after recovered from being rejected by he's straight crush and now set on dates made by the he's friend/former crush to find the big furry hunk of his dreams along with his EDM dream!

[From [url=https://djraptor.itch.io/edm-lover-3]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《EDM LOVER》是一部講述人類與獸人戀愛的同志視覺小說，故事輕鬆又熱鬧。一位立志成為DJ和音樂製作人的年輕人，向暗戀的直男告白被拒，好不容易打起精神，如今又被那位從暗戀對象變回朋友的人安排去相親。他能一邊追逐電子舞曲夢，一邊找到夢寐以求的高大獸人帥哥嗎？

〔摘自[url=https://djraptor.itch.io/edm-lover-3]itch.io[/url]〕
